auth.label: Interview API Key
auth.description: CoderPad Interview API key used with the Authorization header. Enterprise administrators can view or generate it at https://app.coderpad.io/dashboard/settings.

actions.name: create_pad
actions.description: Create a CoderPad interview pad with optional initial content and notes.

title.description: The title displayed for the new pad.

language.description: The CoderPad language identifier for the new pad.

contents.description: The initial source code placed in the pad editor.

notes.description: Private interviewer notes stored with the pad.

inputSchema.description: Initial settings for a new CoderPad interview pad.

owner_email.description: The email address of the pad owner.

anyOf.description: The active programming language, or null before selection.

language.description: The active programming language, or null before selection.

private.description: Whether guests need authorization to view the pad.

updated_at.description: The most recent pad update timestamp.

anyOf.description: The timestamp when the interview ended, or null while active.

ended_at.description: The timestamp when the interview ended, or null while active.

url.description: The URL of the pad editing interface.

playback.description: The URL of the pad playback interface.

outputSchema.description: A CoderPad interview pad returned by the API.

actions.name: get_organization
actions.description: Retrieve profile, users, teams, and sign-on settings for the CoderPad organization.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to retrieve the organization.

status.description: The status string returned by CoderPad.

user_count.description: The number of users in the organization.

organization_default_language.description: The default language for organization users.

single_sign_on_supported.description: Whether the organization supports single sign-on.

actions.name: get_organization_stats
actions.description: Retrieve CoderPad pad usage statistics for an optional time range.

startTime.description: The ISO 8601 start timestamp; endTime is required with it.

endTime.description: The ISO 8601 end timestamp; startTime is required with it.

inputSchema.description: The optional inclusive usage-statistics time range.

status.description: The status string returned by CoderPad.

start_time.description: The start timestamp used for the statistics window.

end_time.description: The end timestamp used for the statistics window.

pads_created.description: The number of pads created in the statistics window.

actions.name: get_pad
actions.description: Retrieve current details for one CoderPad interview pad.

owner_email.description: The email address of the pad owner.

anyOf.description: The active programming language, or null before selection.

language.description: The active programming language, or null before selection.

private.description: Whether guests need authorization to view the pad.

updated_at.description: The most recent pad update timestamp.

anyOf.description: The timestamp when the interview ended, or null while active.

ended_at.description: The timestamp when the interview ended, or null while active.

url.description: The URL of the pad editing interface.

playback.description: The URL of the pad playback interface.

outputSchema.description: A CoderPad interview pad returned by the API.

actions.name: get_question
actions.description: Retrieve one CoderPad interview question by its numeric identifier.

owner_email.description: The email address of the question owner.

anyOf.description: The programming language used by the question.

language.description: The programming language used by the question.

shared.description: Whether the question is shared with the organization.

used.description: The number of times the question has been used.

updated_at.description: The most recent question update timestamp.

outputSchema.description: A CoderPad interview question returned by the API.

actions.name: list_pad_events
actions.description: List recorded participant and execution events for a CoderPad interview pad.

sort.description: The pad or question field and direction to sort by, such as created_at,desc or updated_at,asc.

page.description: The one-based result page to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: The pad and pagination options for retrieving events.

status.description: The status string returned by CoderPad.

anyOf.description: Additional information associated with the event.

metadata.description: Additional information associated with the event.

anyOf.description: The name of the user associated with the event.

user_name.description: The name of the user associated with the event.

anyOf.description: The email address of the user associated with the event.

user_email.description: The email address of the user associated with the event.

events.description: The events on this result page.

total.description: The total number of recorded events.

next_page.description: The URL of the next result page.

prev_page.description: The URL of the previous result page.

outputSchema.description: A paginated list of events recorded for a pad.

ended_at.description: The timestamp when the interview ended, or null while active.

url.description: The URL of the pad editing interface.

playback.description: The URL of the pad playback interface.

items.description: A CoderPad interview pad returned by the API.

pads.description: The pads on this result page.

total.description: The total number of matching pads.
